description: 한국철도공사_연도별 열차키로 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 한국철도공사의 연도별 열차키로 데이터는 증기기관차, 고속철도(KTX), 전기, 디젤 등 다양한 열차 유형별로 한 해 동안 실제로 운행한 총 거리를 집계한 공식 통계 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 열차운행거리 추이, 열차종별 운행 비중, 고속철도 확장, 운행 효율성, 차량 도입 효과. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
